calls.statement:
SELECT s.store_id, s.region, f.channel_code, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date), min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND (s.store_id>=900 OR s.store_id IN (101,114,102,136,129))
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d2, sum(CASE WHEN abs(gross_amount - net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) badvat, sum(CASE WHEN gross_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg, sum(CASE WHEN store_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nostore, min(sale_date), max(sale_date)
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'

calls.statement:
SELECT 
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND sale_date <> CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', timezone('UTC', sale_ts_utc)) AS DATE)) AS date_mismatch,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30') AS stg_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_sales_line_load s WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=s.sales_line_id)) AS stg_not_in_fact,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30') AS days_with_sales,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN s.valid_from AND s.valid_to) AS keys_outside_validity,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE channel_code='ST' AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND channel_id IS NULL) AS st_null_channel

FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN (SELECT sale_date, count(*) n FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1) fl ON fl.sale_date=d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1

calls.statement:
SELECT s.region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gross_sales_aug_2024,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gross_sales_sep_2024
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
  AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY s.region

SELECT s.store_id, f.channel_code, month(f.sale_date) m, sum(f.gross_amount) g, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) staff_g
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id >= 900
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3
